title: Understanding Displacement
text: Displacement is the change in position of an object. Since the particle is moving at a constant velocity, you can calculate displacement using the formula $$s=vt$$.

title: Identify the Given Values
text: You are given the velocity of the particle as $$30\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$ and the time interval as $$5.0\, \text{s}$$. $$ \cup se$$ $$these$$ $$values$$ $$in$$ $$the$$ $$displacement$$ $$formula$$.
